text.p: Close scores and results in four-day Sheffield Shield cricket matches on Sunday:

In Sydney (final day): New South Wales 126 and 337 (Rodney Davison 99); Western Australia 244 (Brad Hogg 59, Brad McNamara five for 75) and 220-1 (Mike Hussey 81 not out, Justin Langer 70 not out). Western Australian won by nine wickets.

In Melbourne (final day): Tasmania 359-7 declared (Daniel Marsh 97) and 264-4 declared (Ricky Ponting 94 not out, David Boon 52), Victoria 284-9 declared and 340-9 (Graeme Vimpani 113, Rohan Larkin 70, Darren Berry 50 not out). Victoria won by one wicket.
In Adelaide (third day): South Australia 527-6 declared (Darren Lehmann 255), Queensland 227 (Wade Seccombe 59) and 220-7 (Matthew Hayden 69).
